parameters.name: AgentRegisterInfoId
parameters.description: The Agent registration ID. This ID is automatically generated by the Alibaba Cloud ATS platform and is globally unique within the platform. The ID is automatically generated during the Agent registration process. When you register or query an Agent by calling API operations, you must carry this ID throughout the entire process. Call the ListAtiAgentRegisterInfos operation to query the target Agent and obtain the AgentRegisterInfoId from the response.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: IdentityCsr
parameters.description: The Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for the identity certificate. You can generate the CSR by following the instructions provided in Step 3 of the Register Agent process in the ATS console.

parameters.name: ServerCertPem
parameters.description: The server certificate, which is the certificate corresponding to the domain name (host address) used by the registered Agent.
